name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Adjust the seat so your shoulders align with the pivots, then rest your outer upper arms against the pads.
Grip the handles lightly and sit tall against the backrest.
Raise both arms smoothly out to the sides until your elbows reach roughly shoulder height.
Lower the pads slowly back to your sides under control without letting the weight stack bang.
tips: Push through the sides of your elbows rather than gripping and pulling hard with your hands.
Avoid shrugging your traps upward as you raise the lever arms.
